verdict.rationale: Gmail's first-party offline mode lets users read, search, and reply to messages without an internet connection, which covers the core of the story. The pack has no independent or hands-on corroboration of offline mode. The only sync complaint (IMAP read-status not propagating) concerns third-party IMAP clients, not Gmail offline. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that offline changes sync on reconnect, evidence of composing new messages (not just replies) offline, independent corroboration of offline reliability.
